title: CurseCore Field Manual
summary: Track curse state, read symptoms, and prepare cleansing routes before consequences stack.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: CurseCore owns curses, corruption, symptoms, cleansing, contracts, and consequence-driven power. The current slice gives RitualCore real player curse targets.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Use Echo Rot samples and diagnostic slips carefully. A curse is a state to read before it becomes a problem to survive.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Gain or detect a curse, read its stage and symptoms, prepare a cleansing route, reduce or cleanse it, then verify the player data changed.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Echo Rot, Glass Veins, player curse data, timed symptoms, diagnostic items, cleansing hooks, and event ids form the live curse layer.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: RitualCore cleanses minor curses, Arcane Index explains curse pages, Grimoire adds warning context, Lens scans curse state, and MissionCore records curse objectives.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If cleansing fails, check that the player actually has an active minor curse and that RitualCore did not consume ingredients before all gates passed.
